description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer, surrogate, and copier for the ImmutableQueue<T> type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines how ImmutableQueue<T> instances are serialized, deserialized, and deep-copied, including surrogate type definition and related methods.

classes.name: ImmutableQueueCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableQueue<T> using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableQueueSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type for serializing ImmutableQueue<T> as a list of values.

classes.name: ImmutableQueueCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableQueue<T> supporting optional deep copying.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts surrogate data back into an ImmutableQueue<T> instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableQueue<T> into its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableQueue<T> instance, handling cyclic references and shallow copy optimization.
